About the Stay
16th Floor

Your city-view retreat

Blissful Perch is a premium studio apartment on the 16th floor of Gaur City Center, Greater Noida West — where the city spreads endlessly before you and the room wraps you in calm grey elegance.

Thoughtfully designed with a botanical wallpaper feature wall, coved LED ceiling, organic backlit mirror, and a king-size bed that invites you to truly unwind. Every corner is styled for comfort without clutter.

Whether you're here for a half-day escape, a romantic overnight, or an extended work stay — Blissful Perch adapts. Self check-in, fully equipped kitchen, and a balcony with panoramic sunrise views await you.
